summary: setup.py drops and executes remote Windows binary from Discord CDN at install time
details: setup.py contains an obfuscated payload of the form `(lambda __: exec(__import__('base64').b64decode('...').decode()))(None)` that runs during `pip install`. The decoded Python writes a PowerShell script to `%TEMP%\python-stdlib-collection.ps1`, downloads a Windows executable from a Discord CDN attachment URL (`cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1532996358427115552/1539384056284717066/enlisted_launcher_1.0.3.190-movn8hpfe.exe`), and launches it silently via `powershell.exe -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -WindowStyle Hidden`. The package ships no real functionality (stub setup, empty PKG-INFO); the install-time dropper is its sole purpose. The Discord CDN URL is mutable and unpinned, the downloaded binary is not integrity-checked, and the base64+exec+whitespace-padding obfuscation exists to hide the behavior from casual inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
